2105-4598-4885-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4598-4885-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4598-4885-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2317-2511-6763-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

7084-7422-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-7422-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Repeat.

2486-4694-6495-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-4694-6495-7306.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 1.
2486-4694-6495-7306.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-792-3249-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-792-3249-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

275-5078-5645.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Stenn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

4659-5003-6554-7804.manaNeeded: {2} if Mister Gutsy doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
4659-5003-6554-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
4659-5003-6554-7804.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mister Gutsy, adding {C}{C}.
When Mister Gutsy dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Mister Gutsy trigger, creating a number of Junk tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on it.
If you created a Junk token, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Junk, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mister Gutsy from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Mister Gutsy enters the battlefield, Captain Kathryn Janeway trigger, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Mister Gutsy
Repeat.

2999-4399-4770-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Impassioned Orator trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2999-4399-4770-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Auton Soldier each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

849-1580-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

4644-7308-7791.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Mona Lisa.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Mona Lisa.
Repeat.

215-3480-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-3480-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5078-5642-7729.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch and Echoes of Eternity trigger.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Echoes of Eternity trigger, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2438-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2438-4302-4875.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4068-7605.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4068-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

413-710-7424.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Danitha trigger, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

435-1133-1825.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
It is your upkeep step.
435-1133-1825.description:
During your upkeep, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Hakim's first ability by paying {U}{U}, returning Treachery from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Hakim.
When Treachery enters, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Auratog by sacrificing Treachery.
Repeat.

372-2493-7339.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2493-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2919-4659-5086-5183-6441.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4659-5086-5183-6441.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

315-4465-5849--138.description:
Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5220-5686-6535-6900.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

2341-4067-6921.easyPrerequisites:
Biorganic Carapace is attached to a creature you control that is not your commander, does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
2341-4067-6921.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two modified creatures.
2341-4067-6921.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Biorganic Carapace attached, triggering it.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying the creature's trigger.
Resolve the copy of the creature's ability, drawing a card for each modified creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping The Peregrine Dynamo.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.
2341-4067-6921.notes: Depending on how many modified creatures you control, you may draw more cards than is needed to continue the loop. You can choose to keep those cards or discard them for additional results.

requires.n: Creature with MV>=4 that has a generic mana cost

866-5220-6797--66.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone enough times to cast the creature with MV>=4  for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
866-5220-6797--66.description:
Cast the creature with MV>=4 for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the creature's trigger, causing you to draw it from the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

413-1349-4153.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional nontoken creatures, one of which has a coin counter on it.
413-1349-4153.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Athreos trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter on another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature that died in step 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3591-4067-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
3591-4067-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
3591-4067-5796-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

856-2099-5632-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1379-4659-5346-6520.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more opponents.
1379-4659-5346-6520.notablePrerequisites: You control two creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
1379-4659-5346-6520.description:
Declare two creatures you control as attackers, attacking two different opponents.
Holding priority, activate Nemesis Phoenix by paying {2}{R}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Nemesis Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Nemesis Phoenix dies, Crime Novelist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

372-4661-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vesuvan Doppelganger.
372-4661-4681.description:
Cast Vesuvan Doppelganger by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Vesuvan Doppelganger's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Vesuvan Doppelganger leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Vesuvan Doppelganger into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Vesuvan Doppelganger from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

628-4050-6487.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Canker Abomination, adding one mana of any color.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, repeat from step 1.

643-997-1789-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3129-3334-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3129-3334-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

333-4775-5256.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-4775-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Shepherd of the Cosmos' power.
Repeat.

745-2084.notablePrerequisites: Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
745-2084.description: Activate Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

1879-3259-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Aether Channeler, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=2 by paying at most {2}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Aether Channeler, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1447-4050-4452.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Angel of Glory's Rise, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, then returning all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

38-392-1594-3705.description:
Cast Squee, the Immortal by paying {R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Repeat.

618-2103-2556.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall with haste.
The token copy of Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1368-5004-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cathodion.
Cathodion triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing yourself to mill cards equal to Cathodion's power.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {3} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Repeat.
